0.title: computable adjudication and agentic test harness
0.content: Computable adjudication and agentic test harness. Also written: caaat-harness, ca&at-harness, .c&at-harness, c@t-harness . Please be introduced to a cat who acquires things, for whatever purpose — maybe somebody knows. Scope: the platform — skills, schemas, processes, the MCP server and the pipeline. Not what a folio IS (that is folio-assist-core), and not any folio’s own content, which lives in its own repository. | cat-harness, in the source Still to be split out of this repository — issue #223. | RTFM — the cat-harness docs The agent–user interaction model, and what this harness is for. | The work plan is where you say what you are doing Claim a bean before you work, so a sibling session does not pick up the same item. | Make your first folio This repository is the platform; your content lives in its own. | Know which kind of thing you are writing A document is structured prose; a paper adds the block kinds whose assertion is a formal claim. | The documentation you will never read All of it. The honest expectation is that you arrive from a search engine when something breaks. | .

1.title: WHO IRIS
1.content: The WHO Institutional Repository for Information Sharing, catalogued by reference: the shape of the corpus is modelled here, and only a handful of its items are held. Browse the replica The catalogue, as a graph .

2.title: What this site is
2.content: . | The replica — IRIS’s home page, community list, collections and items, rendered from this repository’s catalogue and themed as IRIS. It is an ingested copy: not WHO, and not live. | The catalogue — what the catalogue knows, and what it records that it does not know. Every node declares whether its bytes are here (materialized), elsewhere (referenced) or unestablished (unknown), and there is no default. | The gap is the point. IRIS reports its own figures for items and files; the catalogue holds a few and models the rest by reference. The census is bun run cat check:catalogue, never a number written into a page. | . This repository is the development home of the instance; an official copy is expected to live under WHO’s own account.
